_comment: Authoritative, human-authored mapping. Each component declares: figma {name, role, page}, a `mapping` block {type, targets[]} with an explicit code ROLE per target (intent, not name), an optional `code` extraction recipe for the primary target, and `comparisons`. mapping.type ∈ ONE_TO_ONE | ONE_TO_MANY | UNMATCHED | AMBIGUOUS. Names are NOT trusted: same-name components with different roles are flagged AMBIGUOUS. This file supplies NO values (adapters do). Figma Code Connect is unavailable on this seat.
